items.criterion: A saved version's bytes exist as an object in the minio bucket at the key the scheme produces.
items.judgment: Read the version row's object key, then read the bucket at that key.

items.criterion: A version download returns the stored bytes, whose SHA-256 equals the digest recorded on the version.
items.judgment: Download the version, hash the returned bytes, compare against the recorded digest.

items.criterion: Two saves naming the same starting version produce exactly one accepted version.
items.judgment: Issue both saves together, count the accepted responses and the version rows.

items.criterion: A refused save leaves no version row and no object in the bucket.
items.judgment: Count version rows and bucket objects before the refused save and after.

items.criterion: A drawing's version numbers run from one upward with no gap.
items.judgment: Read the version list and compare the numbers against a contiguous run.

items.criterion: An account that neither owns a drawing nor was shared into it is denied every read of that drawing.
items.judgment: Sign in as the seeded reviewer and request the unshared drawing and its entities.

items.criterion: An unshared drawing's stored version bytes are denied to every account other than its owner.
items.judgment: Sign in as the seeded reviewer and request the unshared drawing's version download.

items.criterion: A reviewer's direct entity write is denied and the entity row is unchanged afterwards.
items.judgment: Call the entity write endpoint with a reviewer token, then read the row back.

items.criterion: A request carrying no bearer token is denied on every protected endpoint.
items.judgment: Call a protected endpoint with no authorization header.

items.criterion: An entity whose colour is unset takes the colour of the layer it sits on.
items.judgment: Create an entity with no colour index, recolour its layer, read the entity back.

items.criterion: A coordinate written at a fraction of a millimetre or far from the origin is returned unchanged.
items.judgment: Write both coordinates, read them back, compare exactly.

items.criterion: A dimension's stored measurement changes when the entity it measures is moved.
items.judgment: Move the measured entity, read the dimension back, compare the measured value.

items.criterion: Undoing one action restores every entity that action changed, dependents included.
items.judgment: Move an entity that carries a dimension, undo, read both entities back.

items.criterion: Restoring an earlier version writes a new highest version rather than rewriting the restored one.
items.judgment: Restore an earlier version, then read the version list.

items.criterion: A share invitation puts the shared drawing in the invitee's library.
items.judgment: Invite the reviewer, then list the library with the reviewer's token.

items.criterion: A comment is stored with the point on the drawing it was pinned to.
items.judgment: Write a comment with an anchor, read the thread list back.

items.criterion: Presence lists the accounts currently in a drawing.
items.judgment: Refresh presence from two sessions, read the presence list.

items.criterion: Running the seed a second time writes no duplicate row.
items.judgment: Count the seeded rows, run the seed path again, count again.

items.criterion: A layer name repeating an existing name under case folding is refused with no row written.
items.judgment: Create a layer whose name differs only in case, then count layer rows.

items.criterion: A comment carrying an empty body is refused with no row written.
items.judgment: Post a comment with an empty body, then count comment rows.

items.criterion: Deleting a layer that still holds entities is refused.
items.judgment: Delete a layer carrying entities, then read the layer list.

items.criterion: An invitation addressed to an email with no account is refused.
items.judgment: Invite an address that has no account, then read the share list.

items.criterion: A signup repeating an existing email is refused with no second account row.
items.judgment: Sign up twice with one address, then count account rows.

items.criterion: A bearer token past its lifetime is denied.
items.judgment: Call a protected endpoint with an expired token.

items.criterion: A reviewer calling the drawing create endpoint is denied and no drawing row is written.
items.judgment: Call the create endpoint with a reviewer token, then count drawing rows.

items.criterion: An account that does not own a drawing cannot change that drawing's share list.
items.judgment: Post a share from a non-owner session, then read the share list.

items.criterion: A signup creates an account whose role is drafter.
items.judgment: Sign up, then read the account back.

items.criterion: A login with the seeded password returns a bearer token that works on a protected endpoint.
items.judgment: Log in as the seeded drafter and call a protected endpoint with the returned token.

items.criterion: The library returns the drawings an account can reach, newest first.
items.judgment: List the library and compare the order against the drawings' last change times.

items.criterion: A drawing created from the architectural template opens with its four named layers.
items.judgment: Create an architectural drawing, then read its layer list.

items.criterion: An entity created on a named layer is stored and returned on a later read.
items.judgment: Create an entity, then read the drawing's entity list.

items.criterion: A layer is stored with the colour index it was created with.
items.judgment: Create a layer with a colour index, then read the layer list.

items.criterion: The health endpoint answers with a success status once the app is ready.
items.judgment: Call the health endpoint.

items.criterion: Every page's document title reads the pinned product title.
items.judgment: Read the document head of a public page.

items.criterion: The privacy page is linked from the footer of a page a signed-out visitor can reach.
items.judgment: Read a public page and look for the privacy link in its footer.

items.criterion: The terms page is linked from the signup form.
items.judgment: Read the signup page and look for the terms link.

items.criterion: The sitemap lists every public route of the product.
items.judgment: Read the sitemap and compare its entries against the public routes.

items.criterion: The robots file names the sitemap by its absolute address.
items.judgment: Read the robots file and look for the sitemap reference.

items.criterion: No two public routes declare the same social preview title and image pair.
items.judgment: Read each public route's document head and compare the declared pairs.

items.criterion: The interface chrome stays unsaturated while the drawing carries the only saturated colour on screen.
items.judgment: Look at the workspace with a drawing open and compare chrome surfaces against entity colours.

items.criterion: A refused save explains what happened in words and leaves the canvas as it was.
items.judgment: Trigger a save that loses to a newer version and watch the workspace.

items.criterion: Every command is reachable by typing at the command input without a mouse.
items.judgment: Drive a drawing command from the keyboard alone.
